title: Amazon, Google Each to Own Over 14% of Anthropic Stock After IPO
text: Anthropic PBC is gearing up for its IPO, where key customers will gain considerable equity holdings. Post-IPO, Google, alongside another partner, will oversee almost 29% of Anthropic's shares, bolstered by a significant $10 billion investment from Google for non-voting shares. This deep relationship showcases the dynamic growth in AI technology and underscores the strengthening financial ties in the artificial intelligence sector.

title: Anthropic said to guide IPO price to top of range or above
text: Anthropic is gearing up for a major IPO, aiming to set share prices between $70 and $78. With the potential to amass around $90.4 billion and an additional $26 billion in private placements, demand has already outstripped supply nearly sevenfold. Current investors are likely to have prioritization in share allocations. Noteworthy investor meetings have been planned, including dialogues between Anthropic's CEO and the CEO of JPMorgan Chase.
